title: Contango Converts Remaining Hedge Contracts into Debt
summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. ("Contango" or the "Company") (NYSE American: CTGO) (TSX: CTGO) is pleased to announce that it has amended its credit facility (the "Amended Credit Facility") to convert the remaining 15,000 ounces of hedged gold into debt with its existing lenders.
